description:
H100 Adult Mountain Bike

High-Carbon Steel Frame - Sturdy, durable and more speedy.
Dual Disc Brakes & XC Tires - Fully ensure the safety of the ride.

Suspension Fork - Smoother and more efficient riding experience.
Professional Drivetrain - Provides precise, fast and varied shifting.

Durable and Comfortable

High-carbon steel rigid frame is strong and durable, with large inertia to increase speed. Also, its structure provides you with a more stable operating experience during on-road or off-road riding.

Internal shift cable and brake hose routing can last longer by protecting them from any environment.

Reliable Security

Dual mechanical disc brakes provide you better durability and stopping power, even in slippery ground and weather. Also, it does not damage the rim.

26”/27.5"X 2.1" all terrain tires are lighter, thinner and roll faster to through trails, make riding effortless and non-slip, handle pavement, gravel and dirt with ease. High profile double wall alloy rims are light and strong, able to withstand the bumps of cross-country.

Professional Drivetrain

21-speed shifter and SHIMANO rear derailleur are perfect for a wide gear range and smooth shifts, controlled freely whether ride on flat road or climbing.

Front suspension fork absorbs any bumps and dips encountered on your path, thus it can effectively reduce the obstructive shock during a ride, thus ensuring that you have an ideal comfortable riding experience.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, free pedals and assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

Shimano 21-Speed Drivetrain

3*7 drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting, which gives you more control for climbing, descents and corners to enjoy riding.

Dual Disc Brakes

Dual disc brakes provide better speed control and ensure full control in every situation. Also, it does not damage the rim.

High-Carbon Steel Frame

Hiland high-carbon steel is extremely strong and shock resistant, provides you with a more stable operating experience during on-road or off-road riding.

XC Tire

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials. It has strong grip and puncture resistance. Dual-wall rims allow them to withstand high-intensity riding and protect the inner tube from rupture.

Master any terrain with the Hiland Ridge Mountain Bike. Featuring a 21-speed drivetrain, dual disc brakes, and a high-performance suspension fork for ultimate control and comfort.
